summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Core 10+ Year USD Bond ETF (ILTB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Bloomberg US Universal (10+ Y) index. The fund tracks a broad index of USD-denominated bonds with at least 10 years remaining in maturity. ILTB was launched on Dec 8, 2009 and is issued by BlackRock.
